reads.text: You keep a list of restaurants you will only try with one particular person.

chain.text: A note titled "not yet" lists 31 restaurants. None has a date next to it.
Nine of them also appear in one chat thread, each followed by "when you're back".
The list is less about the food than about who comes along.

reads.text: You name files final_v3_REAL.pdf and you are not proud of it.

chain.text: final.pdf, final_v2.pdf and final_v3_REAL.pdf sit in the same folder.
Versions are tracked by filename, with rising urgency.

reads.text: You would rather fix a bug at 1am than sleep on it.

chain.text: Most weeknight commits land between 11pm and 2am.
Three commit messages say "fix before bed".
An open bug is harder to sleep on than a late night.

reads.text: You keep every birthday card anyone has given you, in one shoebox.

chain.text: A photo album called "cards" holds 140 scans of handwritten cards.

reads.text: Once a month you disappear into reading about shipwrecks.

chain.text: Eleven bookmarks on lost ships and polar expeditions, saved in bursts weeks apart.
A recurring deep dive, not a passing click.

reads.text: You are the one who books the group dinner, and you still arrive last.

chain.text: Four booking confirmations forwarded to a group chat this year.
On each of those nights: "five minutes away", sent after the booking time.
Organizing and punctuality are different skills here.
